 Most recent Most popular Post published at 13:26 GMT 13:26 GMT 
 We've got a poll at the top of this page - Should Bogle have seen red? 
 Refresh the page if it isn't popping up and make your choice!
 303 143 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'They've both lacked in quality' published at 13:24 GMT 13:24 GMT 
 HT: Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Michael Brown 
Former Tottenham and Leeds midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 These long throws are taking ages to set up. 
 They've both lacked in quality but there's been flashes for either side. 
 45 48 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 HALF-TIME published at 13:22 GMT 13:22 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Goalless at the break, with decisions by VAR the main talking point so far.
 142 103 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:21 GMT 13:21 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Mohammed Kudus does well to win a throw down by the corner flag, but Tarik Muharemovic is able to clear when the ball comes back into play.
 96 40 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:18 GMT 13:18 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Ethan Ampadu sends a long throw into the box but Pedro Porro heads away.
 That might well be the last notable action of the half.
 147 62 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Insult to injury for Spurs published at 13:15 GMT 13:15 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Phil McNulty 
BBC Sport chief football writer at Elland Road 
 Spurs will not only feel Leeds United should be down to ten men after Jayden Bogle's late challenge on Mathys Tel, the winger now looks crestfallen after being unable to carry on.
 Dominic Solanke is on, hopefully to liven up what had been a rather dull affair until that incident.
 527 267 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:15 GMT 13:15 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Mohammed Kudus drives a ball across the six-yard box and it flashes inches ahead of Archie Gray's foot but the ex-Leeds man can't react in time. If he did, that would have been a sure goal against his boyhood club.
 166 106 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 get involved Get Involved published at 13:14 GMT 13:14 GMT 
 Click 'Get Involved' to have your say 
 In my opinion that tackle from Bogle was worse than Mateta’s last week. I am not saying Mateta should not have been sent off. VAR inconsistency again. No yellow as well.
 Banger, Newbury 
 That is disgusting challenge no card what a joke VAR.
 Gary, West Sussex 
 1686 528 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 SUBSTITUTION published at 13:13 GMT 13:13 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Mathys Tel looks gutted as he hobbles off. Dominic Solanke replaces him.
 223 279 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:12 GMT 13:12 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Oh actually Mathys Tel doesn't seem to be OK to continue. He's sat on the pitch and clearly hurting where he was caught by Jayden Bogle.
 Tottenham are going to have to make a change here.
 Image source, PA Media 
 209 430 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'It's still a nasty one' published at 13:10 GMT 13:10 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Michael Brown 
Former Tottenham and Leeds midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 They've said no red card. This will create debate. 
 The stud goes into the back of his Achilles, but the one thing I'll say in his defence, his right foot comes round to win the ball but his left foot just plants down. 
 I'll give him the benefit of the doubt but it's still a nasty one. 
 The ref should still go and see it on the monitor. 
 663 416 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:10 GMT 13:10 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 There's boos from the Tottenham fans as Jayden Bogle sends in a great cross but Lukas Nmecha can't direct his header beyond Antonín Kinsky.
 257 70 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Video Assistant Referee published at 13:08 GMT 13:08 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 There's cheers from the home fans as Jayden Bogle is not going to get a red card. VAR has deemed there was no serious foul play there.
 Mathys Tel is OK to continue and we play on.
 Image source, PA Media 
 648 1250 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:07 GMT 13:07 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 It is a long check by VAR. They are really having a thorough check of a couple of different angles.
 254 442 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'He's been down for some time' published at 13:06 GMT 13:06 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Michael Brown 
Former Tottenham and Leeds midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Jayden Bogle caught him on the Achilles and the ref is waiting for Tel. 
 It's a little bit of a concern as he's been down for some time. 
 150 356 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Video Assistant Referee published at 13:06 GMT 13:06 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Oh that's a nasty challenge by Jayden Bogle on Mathys Tel. He's nowhere near the ball as one boot goes down the back of Tel's leg.
 VAR is checking for a possible red card here...
 Image source, Reuters 
 484 390 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:03 GMT 13:03 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Mohammed Kudus sends a corner deep and finds Omar Marmoush but he can't direct his header on target. 
 Only two shots on target so far in this game, both from Tottenham.
 210 127 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 13:01 GMT 13:01 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Antonín Kinsky just gets ahead of Dominic Calvert-Lewin to a ball played through the Tottenham defence, but the flag goes up for offside anyway.
 179 92 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 'Leeds don't know how to change' published at 12:59 GMT 12:59 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Michael Brown 
Former Tottenham and Leeds midfielder on BBC Radio 5 Live 
 Sean Longstaff has not even touched him, it's a silly yellow card. Spurs are growing into the game 
 Spurs have taken the intensity out of Leeds. They're happy to take the ball.
 Leeds don't know how to change and I think that's been the question, Daniel Farke doesn't know how to change the system. 
 Image source, Reuters 
 237 214 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 12:57 GMT 12:57 GMT 
 Leeds 0-0 Tottenham 
 Great bit of defending by Mathys Tel as he sticks a leg out in the air to cut out a pass for James Justin. Had it got through then Justin would have been in on the right.
